why: Captured immediately before pushing the FEAT-002 gift-card commit. That commit adds files under amplify/functions/shared/lambda_utils/, which is a trigger path for seo-tools-deploy.yml, and wecare-seo-tools has no live alias so the workflow publishes straight to $LATEST. This is the revert target if that automatic deploy misbehaves.
rollback: aws lambda update-function-code --function-name wecare-seo-tools restoring the above CodeSha256, or re-run seo-tools-deploy.yml from the prior commit.
